top_signals.title: Kenya Parks $1.9 Billion Vodacom-Safaricom Cash in Bonds Pending Court Ruling
top_signals.summary: Kenya has invested some of the $1.9 billion that Vodacom Group Ltd. paid for a stake in the country’s biggest company in government securities as it awaits the outcome of a court petition opposing the transaction, its treasury secretary said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Nvidia stock up 3% as earnings beat expectations. Neoclouds surge
top_signals.summary: The chip giant's earnings come at a tumultuous time for the company.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
